### reminder to fix the toc rows and section titles that i had errors 
```{r}

```

What I see here is that while the table of contents says

> CHAPTER XXXIII. Back from the Wild

The text says 
>BACK FROM THE WILD
on line 10863.
So to match up the titles from the table of contents 
to the chapters you will need to  chop off everything
up to the "." in the table of contents. 
Then change them to upper case.

```{r}
finn |> 
  # add the line number
  mutate(line_number =row_number()) -> finn

finn |> filter(line_number %in% 33:97) |>
  filter(text != "") -> toc
toc
```
```{r}
toc |> 
  mutate(title = str_extract(text,
                        "(?<=\\.).*") |> 
           toupper() |> trimws(), 
         chapter_title = title) |>
    rename(toc_text = text) |>
     select(-line_number)-> toc
toc
```
Then you can add this information to the original data

```{r}
finn |> left_join(toc, join_by(
  "gutenberg_id" == "gutenberg_id",
   "text" == "title"
  )) |> fill(chapter_title) -> finn
```

At this point you can save the updated file.
THen you can go back and tokenize, stem etc.
This way you can compare the chapters to each other.
